# Task tooltip percentage no longer requires STATUS and its test uses local storage

The tooltip checks percentage independently of status, with a null guard and strict numeric0/100 branches. The new task sets42 with no STATUS and directly checks the tooltip text. Its argument-free createCalendar call uses storage; there is no CalDAV round-trip assertion. The calendar-list Assert.ok has no message. A later timer yield and historical Try reports are separate evidence, and no test or provider operation ran.

Scope: Task tooltip percentage and browser-test scope.
